findings.message: A different agent (Claude) checked the work in a separate headless process.

The test counts in verify.md match the attached logs: full CLI 718 files, 11,624 passed, 14 skipped; release 13 files, 81 tests; targeted 3 files, 15 tests. The code-review JSON matches the claimed approval 13a94973. However, nothing ties those logs to candidate d2100c869. All three logs were built and run in `/private/tmp/safeword-4200-main-evidence/packages/cli`. That directory is not the candidate worktree the document names, and its name suggests a main-branch evidence tree. The same document also mentions separate "tested main builds". The metadata records HEAD only after the fact and does not say which checkout produced the logs. So the headline "fresh full run on the frozen-lockfile tree" could be true of a main build while the candidate claim is false. The document's own check that emitted artifacts match only compares the two logs from that same directory to each other. That leaves the candidate-attribution claim unproven.

The logs are not tied to the candidate. full-cli.log, release.log and targeted.log all show `Using tsup config: /private/tmp/safeword-4200-main-evidence/packages/cli/tsup.config.ts` and `RUN v5.0.3 /private/tmp/safeword-4200-main-evidence/packages/cli`. verify.md says the candidate worktree is `/Users/alex/.codex/worktrees/4200-completion-progress/safeword`, and it separately mentions 'tested main build(s)'. metadata.json records HEAD d2100c869 'recorded_after_completion' but never names the directory that produced the logs or shows what was checked out there. 'emitted_artifacts_match' only compares the full and release builds, both from that same directory. A main-branch build would therefore produce logs that pass every check given here. The claim 'A fresh full run on the frozen-lockfile tree again passes 718 files, 11,624 tests' for the candidate is not proven. This is the same attribution problem verification review 98becbd3 already rejected. To fix it, record `git -C <log cwd> rev-parse HEAD` and `git status` captured at run time, and either explain why `safeword-4200-main-evidence` holds d2100c869 or re-run in the candidate worktree. Also compare the chunk name or hash of the planning-context-identity module against a main build, so the evidence can tell the two builds apart.

The RED evidence (bb2e17ade: one failing regression, six passing) and the earlier failed release run (79 pass, 2 fail) are described but not attached. verify.md says the failures were kept. Attach the log or hash pointers so a reviewer can check them.
verify.md cites 119-test and 96-test runs plus a 15/15 final run, but only the 15/15 targeted log is supplied. The 119-test and 96-test claims are unproven by this packet.

The scope limits are stated honestly: partial fix for #5766, epic #4200 not complete, CLI fixture proof only with no native Codex/Cursor credit, and the warnings from review 13a94973 are kept. Calling the result package-level verification rather than monorepo- or host-level acceptance is appropriately limited.
'Gherkin: PASS' rests only on a focused receipt scenario, with no new feature lane. The wording could suggest broader Gherkin coverage than was actually run.
